verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents an enrichment step that outputs "image descriptions" in its AI-ready JSON, and partitioning produces document elements with metadata, so figures can be described by a model. Nothing in the pack shows chart-specific handling, image crops, or page numbers and coordinates tying each figure back to its source. missing for 10: evidence of image crop/base64 extraction, documented page number or bounding-box coordinates on figure elements, chart-specific VLM summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, figures and charts are extracted or described (VLM summaries, image crops) with positions traceable back to the source page

citations.quote: Create a job to partition and enrich local files into AI-ready JSON with image descriptions, table HTML, named entities, and generative OCR output.
Auto evaluates each page and routes it to Fast, High Res, or VLM partitioning, balancing quality, speed, and cost.

Partitioning converts content from unstructured files and semi-structured data records into structured document elements and metadata in a predefined, consistent, expressive, and contextualized JSON format.
